fields.label: Company
fields.description: A company belongs to one seller. The database enforces it.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: A new company starts off and stays off until somebody changes it.

fields.label: Review Required
fields.description: On by default. Every document waits for a person unless this is turned off.

fields.label: Default Address
fields.description: Used when an invoice names no address of its own.

fields.label: Item For Lines We Cannot Match
fields.description: Optional. Where a supplier's line matches nothing of ours, it goes against this item rather than one being invented. Leave blank to have unmatched lines stop the entry instead.

fields.label: Expense Account
fields.description: Used for lines entered against the item above.
